svg.aria-label: One learner's fragment over time. While training with the default, the learner publishes its delta for a round and keeps training; when the commit arrives it aligns with it, which replaces the steps trained while the round was in flight. With overlap_steps = 0 it waits for the commit instead, and nothing is replaced. At close, by default, it waits for its rounds in flight and the model is set to the newest committed parameters, so the steps trained since the last snapshot are dropped. With flush_on_close = True those steps go out as a final snapshot, and the round made of final snapshots commits Θ − Δ without the outer momentum.
svg.text: trains fragment k from anchor v3
trained while in flight: aligning replaces it
trains fragment k from anchor v3
waits for the commit; nothing is replaced

a final snapshot: a round of final snapshots commits Θ − Δ, without momentum
